blocks.text: com（全部）十press（压）→全部压到一起→压缩。

blocks.label: 派生
blocks.text: compressible/kampresabl/adj.可压缩的

blocks.label: 例句
blocks.text: It's good to let your emotions show, don't repress them.让你的情绪表现出来很好，不要压抑它们。

blocks.label: 记忆法
blocks.text: re（回）十press（压）→压回去一镇压。

blocks.label: 真题
blocks.text: First, suppressed emotions can contribute to stress-related disorders.首先，压抑的情绪会导致压力相关的疾病。

blocks.label: 记忆法
blocks.text: sup(往下）十press（压）一压下去→忍住。

blocks.label: 真题
blocks.text: Jews at the time were severely oppressed and ill-treated in that part of the world.当时的犹太人在世界的那个地区受到严重的压迫和虐待。

blocks.label: 记忆法
blocks.text: op 表示方向；press 表示压。朝着一个方向压，就是“压迫，压抑”。

blocks.label: 派生
blocks.text: oppression/prejn/n.压迫；压抑
